g.text: PWR_FLAG: the rails are sourced by the battery shield (J5); 3V3_DEVKIT by the devkit's LDO.

g.desc: PWR_FLAG: the rails are sourced by the battery shield (J5); 3V3_DEVKIT by the devkit's LDO.

g.text: 1 GND 2 VCC 5V (adapter has its own 3.3 V regulator and level shifter)

g.desc: 1 GND 2 VCC 5V (adapter has its own 3.3 V regulator and level shifter)

g.text: 3 MISO -> IO13 4 MOSI <- IO12 5 SCK <- IO11 6 CS <- IO10

g.desc: 3 MISO -> IO13 4 MOSI <- IO12 5 SCK <- IO11 6 CS <- IO10

g.text: Cell 4.2 V max -> 2.1 V at IO1 (ADC1_CH0, 12 dB).

g.desc: Cell 4.2 V max -> 2.1 V at IO1 (ADC1_CH0, 12 dB).

g.text: 1 5V out (<= 2.2 A cont.) 2 3V out (1 A; measure: 3.0 or 3.3 V) 3 GND 4 B+ (cell)

g.desc: 1 5V out (<= 2.2 A cont.) 2 3V out (1 A; measure: 3.0 or 3.3 V) 3 GND 4 B+ (cell)

g.text: Feeds: +5V -> devkit 5V pin, GNSS, SIM800C board. +3V3 -> OLED, SD, BMA400.

g.desc: Feeds: +5V -> devkit 5V pin, GNSS, SIM800C board. +3V3 -> OLED, SD, BMA400.

g.text: USB, EN, BOOT, JTAG and the onboard RGB LED (IO38/IO48) stay on the devkit.

g.desc: USB, EN, BOOT, JTAG and the onboard RGB LED (IO38/IO48) stay on the devkit.

g.text: SuperMini build: GSM on IO43/IO44 instead of IO17/IO18.

g.desc: SuperMini build: GSM on IO43/IO44 instead of IO17/IO18.

g.text: 1 VCC 3V3 2 GND 3 SDA 4 SCL 5 INT1 -> IO6 (RTC GPIO, deep-sleep wake) 6 INT2 n/c

g.desc: 1 VCC 3V3 2 GND 3 SDA 4 SCL 5 INT1 -> IO6 (RTC GPIO, deep-sleep wake) 6 INT2 n/c

g.text: 1 VCC 5V 2 GND 3 TX -> IO5 4 RX <- IO4

g.desc: 1 VCC 5V 2 GND 3 TX -> IO5 4 RX <- IO4

g.text: 5 SCL / 6 SDA: compass (Foxeer only, 0x0D). BE-220 has pins 1-4.

g.desc: 5 SCL / 6 SDA: compass (Foxeer only, 0x0D). BE-220 has pins 1-4.

g.text: Silkscreen: GND TX (5 V level!) -> IO18 RX <- IO17 PK = BOOT/PWRKEY <- IO7 (open drain) VSS = VCC 5V in NET

g.desc: Silkscreen: GND TX (5 V level!) -> IO18 RX <- IO17 PK = BOOT/PWRKEY <- IO7 (open drain) VSS = VCC 5V in NET

g.text: 6 NET -> R4 1k -> LED1 (NETLIGHT: 0.8 s searching, 3 s registered, 0.3 s GPRS) 7 DTR 8 RING 9-12 audio: unused.

g.desc: 6 NET -> R4 1k -> LED1 (NETLIGHT: 0.8 s searching, 3 s registered, 0.3 s GPRS) 7 DTR 8 RING 9-12 audio: unused.

g.text: TX high side is pulled to VCC through 4.7k on the board: R3 divides it to ~3.0 V for IO18.

g.desc: TX high side is pulled to VCC through 4.7k on the board: R3 divides it to ~3.0 V for IO18.

g.text: VBAT is 3.64 V (MIC29302), 100+10+1 uF already on VCC: short thick wires keep VCC above 4 V in bursts.

g.desc: VBAT is 3.64 V (MIC29302), 100+10+1 uF already on VCC: short thick wires keep VCC above 4 V in bursts.

g.text: Internal pull-up on IO2; GPIO interrupt on both edges.

g.desc: Internal pull-up on IO2; GPIO interrupt on both edges.

g.text: 1 GND 2 VCC 3V3 3 SCL <- IO9 4 SDA <> IO8

g.desc: 1 GND 2 VCC 3V3 3 SCL <- IO9 4 SDA <> IO8

g.text: Module pull-ups on SDA/SCL; bus at 100 kHz.

g.desc: Module pull-ups on SDA/SCL; bus at 100 kHz.
